constraints.paraphrase: You usually wake up at 7:00, so no work is scheduled before then.

unsupported.source: Wake me up at 7 with an alarm.
unsupported.reason: Friday only plans your schedule. It can't set alarms or send wake-up notifications, so you'll need your phone's alarm for that.
